title: morus rubra var. canadensis
intro: Morus rubra var. canadensis, commonly known as Red Mulberry, is a deciduous tree native to Eastern North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and aiding in weight management. The therapeutic actions of Red Mulberry include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective properties, attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which have been identified as morusin, rubusoside, and kaempferol.
